The Senior Legal Counsel, Transformation & Service Enablement leads the design, transition and continuous improvement of legal services within FNZ’s India Legal, Risk & Compliance Shared Services Hub. * Lead the Hub transition, transformation and service-enablement portfolio.
* Design and mobilize scalable services, processes, controls, documentation and hand-offs.
* Drive responsible AI, workflow automation, self-service and contract-process optimization within owner governance.
* Coordinate Hub knowledge, templates, playbooks, SOPs and change-adoption activity while preserving substantive ownership.
* Use operational data to prioritize improvement and demonstrate benefits.

### **Specific Role Responsibilities**

**1. Transition and Mobilization**

* Own transition plans, workstream governance, milestones, risks, dependencies and stakeholder communications for new services entering the Hub.
* Lead discovery, scope confirmation, process mapping, knowledge transfer, training packs, readiness assessment, hyper care and stabilization.
* Define entry, exit and BAU acceptance criteria with the Service Delivery & Workforce leader and relevant onshore owner.
* Conduct post-transition reviews and apply lessons learned to future mobilizations.
* Maintain a transition pipeline aligned to the phased service catalogue and avoid mobilizing work whose ownership, risk treatment or prerequisites are unresolved.

**2. Process, Knowledge and Service Design**

* Design fit-for-purpose intake, triage, workflow, escalation, quality and control processes.
* Create and maintain process maps, SOPs, operating documentation, training packs and controlled hand-off materials.
* Coordinate template, precedent, clause-library and playbook administration, version control and implementation using content approved by the relevant onshore legal owner.
* Assess new service requests for feasibility, standardization, automation potential, capability needs and transition readiness.

**3. Legal Technology, AI and Automation**

* Develop and deliver a prioritized portfolio of Hub legal-technology, AI and automation use cases within approved governance.
* Lead workflow automation, self-service, clause automation, abstraction and AI-agent pilots where allocated to the Hub.
* Partner with Legal Operations, Procurement, Technology, Information Security, Privacy and onshore Legal teams on design, controls, testing and deployment.
* Document use cases, assumptions, risks, testing and decisions, with clear human oversight and escalation controls.
* Build adoption plans, user testing, benefits measures and post-implementation reviews with the delivery leader and platform owner.

**4. Continuous Improvement, Data and Change**

* Use operational and stakeholder data to identify bottlenecks, root causes, standardization and redesign opportunities.
* Own the Hub improvement roadmap and project governance, with clear outcomes, owners, dependencies and benefits.
* Coordinate KPI dashboards, trend analysis and management information for improvement purposes, while respecting Legal Operations ownership of ExCo, Board or enterprise reporting where applicable.
* Lead change impact assessment, communications, training, adoption and reinforcement for new processes and tools.
* Develop new Hub service propositions jointly with delivery and onshore owners once legal, operational and technology prerequisites are met.

* Substantial experience leading legal-service transitions, transformation programmers, projects or legal-operations initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience in process design, SOPs, controls, knowledge enablement and organizational change.

* Legal-process design, standardization and control thinking.
* Practical AI, automation and legal-technology enablement.
* Change management, adoption and stakeholder engagement.

**Analyst AML KYC/Sanctions:**  
Global Legal & Compliance Unit at JBS Gurgaon
  
  
What this job involves
  
  
The AML & KYC / Sanctions Screening Analyst is a role under JLL’s Global Legal Compliance (GLC) team. The KYC / Sanctions Screening Analyst will be located in a JLL Business Services (JBS) shared service centre, and will report to the Compliance / Sanctions Screening Manager within JBS.
  
  
**The KYC / Sanctions Screening Analyst will be responsible for:**
  

* Offering compliant workarounds / alternatives where confronted by obstacles to complete AML KYC;
* Reviewing and resolving false positives from automated daily ongoing screening;
* Manual uploads of names for initial screening in JLL’s global sanctions screening system;
* Extracting data from screening system and forwarding screening results to relevant parties within JLL;
* Escalating potential true matches to appropriate parties within JLL, according to sanctions screening escalation procedures, for further investigation and resolution;
* Ensuring screening procedures are followed consistently with a documented audit trail for all KYC / sanction match resolution actions taken;
* Reviewing preliminary KYC / AML materials liaising with relevant business and local legal & compliance counterparties in line with JLL’s minimum global standards

**Sound like you? To apply you need to be:** –
  
  
The KYC / Sanctions Screening Analyst must have a good knowledge and understanding of sanction law requirements, AML Regulations and KYC best practices, in addition to good technical skills to be able to navigate JLL’s sanctions screening system, extract data from the system and forward to others for escalation and resolution procedures. This includes proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and Adobe PDF. The Analyst must also be able to efficiently identify false matches and conduct initial investigation into potential true matches, and must have good communication and organizational skills to work with local Legal & Compliance teams and continuously follow up on open cases through proper resolution of potential matches identified in the system.
  
  
The AML checks to be conducted on Clients and counterparties which will include: (i) listed companies (and their subsidiaries), (ii) regulated companies (and their subsidiaries), (iii) private individuals and families, (iv) trusts, foundations and unincorporated associated, (v) governments and public authorities, (vi) private and unlisted companies (including special purpose vehicles).
  
An ability to navigate JLL’s Customer Relationship Management (e.g. Salesforce, MS Dynamics) and AML KYC systems (e.g. World Check, Bureau Van Dyke), extract data from the system and forward to others for escalation and resolution procedures is important. This includes proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and Adobe PDF.
  
The Analyst must also be able to identify false matches efficiently and conduct initial investigation into potential true matches of PEPs / Sanctions / Negative, and must have good communication and organisational skills to work with the EMEA AML Team and continuously follow up through to conclusion any open AML KYC checks
  
  
Key skills
  
  

* Prior experience with a large multinational financial institution in respect of sanctions screening and AML/KYC Checks, as well as familiarity with the US OFAC and other international sanctions laws is essential.
* Candidate needs to have some India specific AML experience, as well as familiarity with the other international sanctions laws is essential.
* Minimum 1 years’ experience with Global sanctions screening, Anti-Money Laundering, Know Your Client checks or compliance related field, and with a large multinational financial institution or similar.

Employee specification
  
  

* 2-year Associate’s Degree or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of OFAC and other international sanctions laws and Money Laundering Regulations.
* Good technical skills – proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook, and Adobe PDF and online research tools.
